## Activity

During May 2025, East City Eye Clinic recorded 235 captures. This report summarises activity for the month and provides a brief account of image quality and grading outcomes. The capture total represents the images submitted through the clinic’s service during the reporting period. Activity should continue to be reviewed alongside image quality and grading measures to support consistent service delivery and timely review.

## Image quality

Of the 235 captures, 4 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.7. This measure should continue to be monitored as part of routine site operations. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be tracked and addressed through the appropriate process. Clear records of equipment concerns and image quality outcomes will support ongoing operational review.

## Grading

Grading identified 68 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. The results provide a summary of the grading workload and the time between image capture and completion of grading. The site should continue to monitor referable findings and grading lag through routine reporting, with attention to maintaining timely review and consistent documentation of activity, image quality and grading outcomes.
